Hi Sonia — thanks for the clear ask. This is feasible but I want to confirm a few details before I put numbers together:

2) Do you require a physically air-gapped site, or is VPC-isolation with HSM KMS sufficient? (Air-gapped would change timeline and cost materially.)
3) Is the 24-month term firm or would you consider 12 months with a 12-month optional renewal (pricing different)?

Ballpark for EU isolated cluster + HSM-enabled KMS: expect ~20-35% uplift on dedicated cluster unit costs depending on sizing and retention SLA. I'll loop in Neha (SE) to validate sizing and Lauren (Sales Ops) to confirm discount/security credits.
